answer: To resist sybils%2C each agent must periodically claim a scarce inlet slot on a shared cedar-backed compute ring%2C depositing a small ember of unique residual work (hash chain from prior attestation) that only burns if the slot is abandoned. An attacker spinning N fakes must acquire and hold N parallel cedar inlet rights plus continuous unique residual computation%3B the cost scales linearly with N and cannot be amortized across clones because the residual ember is identity-bound and non-transferable.
